document.label: Photo ID (RG or driver's license)
document.purpose: Upload the front and the back. We will check that the name on the document matches the name you entered.
document.limits: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {max} MB

document.tip1: Show the whole document, with all four edges visible.
document.tip2: Avoid glare and shadows. Do not use flash.
document.tip3: Do not cover any part with your fingers.

socialName.title: Trans person whose ID has not been updated yet?
socialName.text: Upload your document as usual. If the name does not match, you can send a photo of a handwritten letter with your chosen name (nome social) and CPF, and our team will review it confidentially.

legal.draftNotice: Draft under legal review. The final text will be published before launch.

rejected.title: Upload your document again
rejected.description: The name on the ID didn't match your account name. This is common (accents, abbreviations, married names) and the team reviews each case carefully. Send the front and back again, with a clear photo showing the full name.

pending.title: Document under review
pending.description: We received the front and back of your document. Our team will check the name and let you know as soon as it is done.

blocked.title: Account under team review
blocked.description: The name on the ID didn't match your account in two attempts. For your safety, renting and listing are paused until the team reviews the case with you.
blocked.canBrowse: You can still browse the site. The operations team will contact you to sort it out.

approved.title: Identity verified
approved.description: The name on your document matches your account. You are all set to rent and list.

letter.title: Are you a trans person whose ID does not yet show your chosen name?
letter.description: You can ask us to review your account. Upload a photo of a handwritten letter with:

help.title: Help center
help.subtitle: Quick answers and a chat with the Hi Scoot team.

how.q: How do I pay for a booking?
how.a: Through Mercado Pago, by card, no account needed. Payment is only requested after the Host accepts, and you have 10 minutes to pay.

when.a: Only after the Host accepts, when you pay. Requesting a booking costs nothing.

deadlines.q: How long does the Host have to answer?
deadlines.a: Up to 20 minutes when pickup is the same day, and up to 24 hours when it's scheduled. If the deadline passes, the time is free again: you can request again or message the Host.

cancel.a: Yes, up to 24 hours before pickup. If you cancel a paid booking, you get the rental back; the 15% platform fee isn't refunded. If the Host cancels, you get everything back.

pickup.a: At the agreed time, scan the QR code on the equipment (or type the code), take a photo and confirm. The Host confirms too. Return works the same way.

late.a: Each late hour is charged at the equipment's hourly price + 15%. If you'll be late, message the Host as soon as possible.

who.q: Who is responsible for damage or theft?
who.a: The Rider is responsible for the equipment during the rental period, from pickup to return. Pickup and return photos record the equipment's condition.

emergency.q: What to do in an emergency?
emergency.a: First, stay safe and call 192 (ambulance), 193 (fire) or 190 (police). Then use the SOS button on your active booking: it alerts the Hi Scoot team and the Host right away.

document.q: Why do you ask for my ID?
document.a: For everyone's safety, the ID is requested when you rent or list. The team checks it by hand. Accent, abbreviation or married-name differences are common and the team sorts them out with you.

phone.a: Only the other person in the booking, and only after it's accepted.

paid.a: As soon as the Rider pays, your share goes straight to your Mercado Pago account. When you can withdraw depends on your Mercado Pago account. See Host → Earnings.

visible.q: Why isn't my listing in search?
visible.a: It must be approved by the team, available and have open days. Use "Repeat every week" in Available days so you don't forget.
